AssetTag.description: the quoted SHA-256 of the file's bytes, which the next request sends back as If-None-Match

ContentDisposition.description: the file name the merged profile is offered under

ETag.description: the stored policy revision, quoted, which the next write sends back as If-Match

Location.description: the route the answer points at

PprofCollection.description: the Collection the profile came from

PprofTargetNode.description: the node that Pod runs on

PprofTargetPod.description: the Pod the profile came from

PprofTargetVersion.description: the version label of the profiled Pods

RequestId.description: the identifier of this request, the client's own when it sent one the gateway takes and a generated one otherwise. It is on every response of both listeners.

WaitElapsed.description: how long the request was held open, in decimal seconds with millisecond precision. It is on every answer to a request that carried a wait the gateway accepted.

AuthCode.description: the authorization code the issuer sent the browser back with
AuthCode.name: code

AuthError.description: the failure the issuer sent the browser back with instead of a code
AuthError.name: error

AuthState.description: the value that ties the answer to the login this browser started
AuthState.name: state

CollectionID.description: the Collection identifier, which is opaque
CollectionID.name: id

ConsoleFile.description: the remainder of the path, separators included; the console resolves it
ConsoleFile.name: file

Cursor.description: continue after the entry a previous response's nextCursor names. It is opaque, and it is refused beside a filter set other than the one it was minted under.
Cursor.name: cursor

Explain.description: ask for the counts that say why Pods were left out
Explain.name: explain

IdempotencyKey.description: the key a create is retried under: 1 to 128 bytes drawn from [A-Za-z0-9._-]. It is optional, and it is scoped to the principal, the namespace, and the Service. A repeat carrying the same policy snapshot is answered with the Collection the first request created; one carrying a different snapshot is 409 idempotency_mismatch and creates nothing.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IfNoneMatch.description: an entity tag the caller already holds, or *; a match is answered 304 with no body
IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match

Limit.description: how many entries the page carries at most
Limit.name: limit

Origin.description: keep only Collections of that origin
Origin.name: origin

Pod.description: keep only this Pod, named as a DNS-1123 subdomain
Pod.name: pod

Port.description: the pprof port to connect to; it excludes portName, and a value discovery.pprof.allowedSelections does not admit is refused
Port.name: port

PortName.description: the container port name to connect to; it excludes port, and a value discovery.pprof.allowedSelections does not admit is refused
PortName.name: portName

Return.description: the path the browser is sent back to once the login completes
Return.name: return

Seconds.description: how long to profile for, on the profiles that take a duration. Absent means the profile's default; a value above the configured limit is refused.
Seconds.name: seconds

Since.description: keep only Collections created at or after this instant
Since.name: since

State.description: keep Collections in any of the named states; absent keeps every state
State.name: state

Strategy.description: how one Pod is chosen from the eligible ones
Strategy.name: strategy

Version.description: keep only Pods carrying this version label
Version.name: version

Wait.description: hold the request open until the record's state moves, or until the wait ends. A value outside the grammar is refused rather than clamped.
Wait.name: wait

schema.description: a duration between 1s and 60s, such as 1s, 30s, or 60s

Artifact.description: the merged profile, streamed from the store

AuthInfo.description: how to authenticate to this gateway

CollectionAccepted.description: the Collection was accepted and Location names it

CollectionMismatch.description: the key stands for a request whose policy snapshot differs from this one, and nothing was written. The body carries no details: the fault is in no one input.

CollectionReplayed.description: this key already names a Collection, and the answer reports it rather than accepting it again. Location names the same Collection the first answer carried.

CollectionWaited.description: the Collection as stored, read after the wait ended

Collections.description: one page of the Service's Collections

ConsoleAsset.description: one console file, under the content type its name says

ConsoleAssetHead.description: the headers the same request would answer a GET with, and no body

ConsoleHead.description: the headers the same request would answer a GET with, and no body

Error.description: an error the gateway wrote itself. A 405 carries Allow with the methods the route accepts, and a 429 may carry Retry-After.

Limits.description: the bounds this gateway serves under

NotModified.description: the file the caller already holds has not changed

OpenAPI.description: this document, served byte for byte from the binary

PolicyCreated.description: the override was written for a Service that had none

PolicyDeleted.description: the override is gone and the Service is back on the defaults

Profile.description: the profile bytes, streamed from the Pod that was profiled, under the status, body, and content type the application answered with

Redirect.description: the browser is sent on, and Location names where

Services.description: the Services the realm admits in that namespace

Whoami.description: the caller and the realm it was resolved to

AuthInfoResponse.description: what a client reads before it holds a credential: the authentication mode, and the device login where one is configured.

CollectionAck.description: what a create answers with: the identifier to poll, and the state the record holds.

CollectionOrigin.description: what created the Collection. Later work can add a value, so a client that switches on it needs a default arm.

CollectionRecord.description: the Collection as stored. It names namespaces, Services, Pods, and nodes, and never a Pod address or a pprof port.

configRevision.description: the policy revision the snapshot was taken at, 0 when the Service had no override

idempotencyKey.description: the key the creator sent, which is that caller's own text

slot.description: the scheduled instant, absent for a Collection a client asked for

snapshotHash.description: the hash of the canonical policy snapshot, which a retried create is compared against

CollectionRequest.description: what one Collection asks for, replacing the Service's effective policy field by field. Every field is optional and the empty object is valid. enabled and schedule are refused: a Collection runs once and schedules nothing.

CollectionState.description: the state of a Collection. The set is closed for this release.

CollectionSummary.description: one entry of a Collection listing.

CollectionsResponse.description: one page of a Service's Collections, newest first. nextCursor is present only when the listing has more entries to give.

Error.description: the envelope every error the gateway writes itself carries. code is the stable contract; error is human-readable and may change.

code.description: the stable code of the failure

details.description: the inputs the caller has to change. The key is absent for a code with no vocabulary, and is never null and never empty.

ErrorDetail.description: one input the caller has to change.

code.description: which refusal this is, from the vocabulary of the envelope's own code

field.description: the input at fault: a JSON pointer into the body, a query parameter name, a header name, or empty when no single input is at fault. The item's code says which of the four it is.

Exclusion.description: how many Pods one reason kept out of the target set.

LimitExceededDetailCode.description: the vocabulary of limit_exceeded, one value per way an effective policy misses a bound.

LimitsResponse.description: the bounds and the selections this gateway serves under.

Manifest.description: what the merged profile was built from.

truncated.description: a round had more eligible Pods than it sampled

NamespacesResponse.description: the namespaces the caller's realm admits that hold a Service.

Owner.description: the worker that holds the Collection's lease. It names no address.

Policy.description: an effective collection policy: every field filled, from the defaults and any override.

PolicyOverride.description: the fields an override sets. Layering is one level deep per block, so a field absent from it falls back to the defaults.

PolicyResponse.description: the Service's stored override and the effective policy it produces.

PortSelection.description: one admitted selection: a port number, a port name, or the wildcard in place of either.

Progress.description: the owner's last renewal snapshot, which is informational.

Realm.description: what the caller's realm admits. A list entry is the wildcard or an exact name.

RealmPGO.description: the three collection permissions of a realm.

Replicas.description: how many Pods a round samples: a count, or "all" for every eligible Pod.

Sample.description: one profile the Collection took, and what came of it.

ServicesResponse.description: the Services of one namespace the caller's realm admits.

Target.description: one backend Pod of a Service. It never carries an address or a resolved port.

version.description: the Pod's version label, empty when it carries none

TargetsResponse.description: the eligible backends of a Service, sorted by Pod name. selectorMatched and excluded are present only for a request that asked to be told why.

selectorMatched.description: how many Pods the Service's selector matched

Violation.description: one policy field that misses a bound. field is the dotted policy field; the details array of a refusal writes the same field as a pointer.

ceiling.description: the configuration key that bounds the field

WhoamiResponse.description: the caller as the gateway resolved it.

logout.description: the path a browser session ends at, absent where none is configured

info.description: Profgate is a Kubernetes-aware pprof gateway. It resolves a Service to its backend Pods, proxies pprof profiles, and collects merged CPU profiles for profile-guided optimization. Every route below is served by the API listener, and this document describes all of them whatever the configuration enables. The ops listener's health and metrics paths are not in it. Every response carries X-Request-Id and Cache-Control: no-store.
info.title: Profgate Gateway API

get.description: Sends the browser to the console.
get.summary: Reach the console from the root

head.description: The headers the same request would answer a GET with, and no body.
head.summary: Reach the console from the root, headers only

get.description: Reads the issuer's answer, sets the session cookie, and sends the browser where the login started.
Sends the browser to the issuer and seals the transaction in a cookie.
Clears the session cookie and sends the browser on.
The operator console, which reads this API as any other client does and adds no permission.

head.description: The headers the same request would answer a GET with, and no body.

get.description: One file of the console tree, addressed by the remainder of the path.

head.description: The headers the same request would answer a GET with, and no body.

get.description: The authentication mode, and the device login where one is configured. The route runs no authentication step: it is what a client reads before it holds a credential.
The record as stored. With a wait, the request is held open until the state moves, the wait ends, or the replica drains.

post.description: A Collection that has already finished answers 409 collection_terminal. No body is accepted.

requestBody.description: the route reads no body and refuses one that carries bytes; the media type is declared all the same

get.description: Streamed from the store. A Collection that has not completed answers 409, and one whose bytes are gone answers 410.
The duration ceilings, the profiles it serves, the port selections it admits, and whether collection is enabled.
get.summary: Describe the bounds this gateway serves under

get.description: The namespaces the caller's realm admits that hold at least one Service.
get.summary: List the namespaces the caller may reach

get.description: The Services of that namespace the caller's realm admits.
get.summary: List the Services the caller may reach in one namespace

get.description: Newest first, by creation instant and then by identifier. Filters apply first, then the cursor, then the page bound.

post.description: The Collection runs against the Service's effective policy with this body's fields replacing it. The answer names the Collection; the profile is fetched from the download route once it completes.

get.description: The newest Collection whose merged profile is still stored. A Service with none answers 404 collection_not_found, which covers one that has never collected and one whose artifacts have all expired.
get.summary: Read the newest completed Collection of a Service

get.description: The merged profile of the same Collection the record route answers with, so a build fetches the newest usable profile in one request.
get.summary: Download the newest completed Collection's profile

delete.description: The Service returns to the operator defaults and stops being scheduled. If-Match is required over an existing override and names the revision the delete is made at.

get.description: The stored override, the effective policy it produces, and the fields of that policy which miss a current bound.

put.description: The body is the override, not the effective policy. If-Match is required over an existing override and names the revision the write is made at.

get.description: The gateway picks one eligible Pod, confirms it, and streams the profile it answers with. A non-2xx answer from the application passes through with its own status, body, and content type.
get.summary: Fetch one profile from one Pod of a Service

get.description: The Pods the Service selects that the gateway would profile, sorted by Pod name. No entry carries a Pod address or a resolved port.
get.summary: List the eligible backends of a Service

get.description: The document describes every route the API listener serves, whatever the configuration enables. The route runs no authentication and no realm step: what it publishes is the route grammar.
The principal the credential resolved to, and what its realm admits.
